summary: Slow, small start to the week everywhere with Saturday shaping up as the clear standout — N offshore winds clean up modest swell across all five spots, and the drive pays off best at Ditch and Matunuck where 2-plus feet lines up with morning offshore. Midweek belongs to Manasquan: Thursday brings the biggest swell of the week to 3.7ft with S wind only cross there, while Long Island gets the same swell blown out by straight onshore. Rockaway is fine at home Saturday morning but smaller than the drives — building into Thursday, cleaning up Saturday, then fading soft and junky again by Monday.
